title: Soviet psychics tasked against US congressmen, senators, cabinet and president

tellings.quote: times so they taught their psychics to Target American Congressman uh Senators

plain: The Soviet Union is said to have trained its psychics to spy on American leaders: congressmen, senators, cabinet members and the president. Joe McMoneagle tells Michels this second-hand, saying it came from a box of material from a Soviet psychic unit. If true, the Soviets were using psychic spying aimed right at the top of the US government.
